I also struggled with how grading issues were handled. Volkan Hoca, gördüğüm en iyi öğretmenlerden biri. Dersi etkileyici ve genel olarak ilgi yaratıcı şekilde işliyor. Anlattığı konudan kendisinin de zevk alması konuyu daha etkileyici ve içine düşülesi bir konu haline getiriyor. İnanılmaz derecede interaktif oluyor dersleri. Herkese zaman ayırıyor ve profesyonel olmadığı konularda bilmiyorum diyebiliyor araştırıyor, araştırmayı öğretiyor. Bir konuyu daha iyi anlayalım diye anlaşılması zorsa ekstra kendi daha önceden uyarıyor, böylece daha çok üzerinde duruyor ve beyin fırtınası yapıyoruz. İngilizce olan bu öğrenim sürecinde sorun yaşayacağımı düşünmüştüm ama bana interaktif şekilde ders işleten Volkan Hoca sayesinde büyük bir özgüven geliştirdim. Önceden sahil olduğum düşünce sisteminin inanılmaz derecede geliştiğini hissediyorum. Bana bir bilim adamının nasıl düşünmesi gerektiğini öğreten hocam oldu. Volkan Hoca was an amazing instructor and he helped us a lot throughout the semester. He was also true to his words about what he "could" ask in the exams. He asked what he said we would and graded them fairly quickly afterwards. Some downsides could be that sometimes at the end of lectures, some topics and slides felt a bit rushed and got mixed up. Maybe he could save those topics up for later lectures?..
Another thing was that quizzes could be more in numbers, so that there could be a better possibility to get a higher average, instead of just the two.
One last thing was that the idea of bonuses is beneficial, but not to all students. While some get the bonuses, some don't and this leads to a disinterest in the lectures. This happens because however much you work on your answer (even if its logical to you), it might not be sufficient for him and he will still not give you the bonus. All that put aside, Volkan Hoca is simply AMAZING and was very capable in teaching all of what MBG101 had to offer. Even though his primary field was Bioinformatics, he was still very interested in all of the subjects and taught them very well. We are all so glad to have had him...

Positive Aspects: The lessons were very fun and informative. The instructor's narrative style and analogies were successful. The topics covered were ideal for an introductory course.

Negative Aspects: I think the number of topics was too high and I think it is completely unreasonable to expect so many topics to be completed in one semester. Especially the topics covered in the last three weeks were covered very quickly and were not even on the final exam. Also, protein purification experiments were not done in our laboratory lessons. The best advice I can give to the lecturer would be to take questions from the students at the end of the course so that he can cover the topics more easily. Also, since there was no homework part in the grading of this course, we were not given homework and this made it difficult for us to study. If there was a homework system like in our other courses, we could study more easily and more often.
